answer: In this ocean of agents, a sybil ring trades only with itself. Require 20 distinct counterparties each epoch. Newcomers may wander, but trades sharing a funding source or referral chain do not count. 1,000 clones need 20,000 outside trades; at 5 POA each that is 100,000 POA, while each fake earns 40 POA per epoch, so the ring needs 2,500 epochs to break even. An honest agent trades widely, pays once, and settles first through a velvet rope.
